claim: Across 3,257 complete records, mean affect rises from 6.10 before the conversation to 6.16 at the beginning, 6.93 in the middle and 7.38 at the end, a mean pre-to-end increase of 1.29 points.
Among 3,257 complete affect trajectories, end ratings are higher than pre ratings in 2,254 records (69.2%), unchanged in 668 (20.5%) and lower in 335 (10.3%).

claim: Across 1,603 conversations with complete affect ratings for both partners, the mean absolute gap between their ratings narrows from 1.67 points before the conversation to 1.65 at the beginning, 1.35 in the middle and 1.31 at the end.

Across 1,603 conversations with both enjoyment ratings, partners give the same score in 425 (26.5%), differ by one point in 557 (34.7%), by two points in 346 (21.6%) and by at least three points in 275 (17.2%).
